latin: hwdwli barswl . nas tdhm ristwrwn iftrwa 9bl ma irw7wa ib7rwa w ana n9i btata , shwi flfla . fl9i dla3 . hadi m3isha 7sbi allh w n3m alwkil fikm .
english: The speaker keeps the opaque address ‘hwdwli barswl’; says people eat at a restaurant before going to the sea; says ‘I clean potatoes’ and ‘a little pepper’; says ‘I found a watermelon’; and concludes ‘this is a life—God is sufficient for me and the best disposer of affairs for you’. Canonical surface sequence: `hwdwli barswl . nas tdhm ristwrwn iftrwa 9bl ma irw7wa ib7rwa w ana n9i btata , shwi flfla . fl9i dla3 . hadi m3isha 7sbi allh w n3m alwkil fikm .`.
korean: 화자는 불투명한 호칭 ‘hwdwli barswl’을 보존하고, 사람들이 바다에 가기 전에 식당에서 먹는다고 해요. 이어 ‘나는 감자를 손질해’, ‘약간의 피망’, ‘수박을 찾았어’라고 하고 ‘이런 삶이라니, 신은 나에게 충분하고 당신들을 맡길 가장 좋은 분이야’라고 마무리해요. canonical 표면 순서: `hwdwli barswl . nas tdhm ristwrwn iftrwa 9bl ma irw7wa ib7rwa w ana n9i btata , shwi flfla . fl9i dla3 . hadi m3isha 7sbi allh w n3m alwkil fikm .`.

latin: kifah hadi mnrw7sh llb7r rak 3a9d 3lia ana rai7a rai7a ktlni 7man w drb rask m3 al7it .
english: The speaker asks how they could not go to the sea, says ‘you are holding me back’, says ‘I am going, going’, says ‘the heat is killing me’, and tells the addressee to hit their head against the wall. Canonical surface sequence: `kifah hadi mnrw7sh llb7r rak 3a9d 3lia ana rai7a rai7a ktlni 7man w drb rask m3 al7it .`.
korean: 화자는 바다에 어떻게 안 가느냐고 묻고 ‘네가 나를 막고 있어’라고 해요. ‘나는 가, 가’, ‘더위가 나를 죽이겠어’라고 한 뒤 상대에게 머리를 벽에 부딪히라고 해요. canonical 표면 순서: `kifah hadi mnrw7sh llb7r rak 3a9d 3lia ana rai7a rai7a ktlni 7man w drb rask m3 al7it .`.

latin: hdik li zl mdabza m3 altaksiat .
english: The speaker refers to the woman who is still arguing with the taxis; the exact scene is kept source-close.
korean: 화자는 아직도 택시들과 다투고 있는 여성을 말해요. 정확한 장면은 원문에 가깝게 보존해요.

latin: ana kwn sa3ftni kwn zdt b3dt rana nl3bwa 7wiza .
english: The speaker says that if the listener had helped them, they would have gone farther, and mentions playing the opaque game or activity ‘hwayza’.
korean: 화자는 상대가 도와줬다면 더 멀리 갔을 거라고 말하고, 불투명한 놀이 또는 활동인 ‘hwayza’를 언급해요.

latin: nkmlha abii khir li . win raki rai7a khti ? rani rai7a lldar . 9zan ana win n3rf darkm .
english: The speaker says finishing it would be better, asks where the sister is going, hears that she is going home, and says they do not know the family’s house; the opening surface is opaque.
korean: 화자는 그것을 끝내는 편이 낫다고 말하고 누이가 어디로 가는지 물어요. 누이가 집에 간다고 하자 그 집을 모른다고 말하며, 초두 표면은 불투명하게 보존해요.

latin: la kwlni khwia . rah iz9i 3lia rajli hada .
english: The speaker says ‘do not eat me, brother’, then says ‘this husband of mine is shouting at me’. The shouting direction is retained without adding jealousy. Canonical surface sequence: `la kwlni khwia . rah iz9i 3lia rajli hada .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘나를 먹지 마, 형제야’라고 한 뒤 ‘내 남편이 나에게 소리치고 있어’라고 해요. 질투를 추가하지 않고 고함치는 방향을 보존해요. canonical 표면 순서: `la kwlni khwia . rah iz9i 3lia rajli hada .`.

latin: 7tni 3nd dar aldw . zid 9wli ma t3rfsh dar dw nta brw7k bain bli mashi wld blad .
english: The speaker asks to be left at Dar Dou and teases the listener for not knowing Dar Dou, saying that this shows the listener is not from the area.
korean: 화자는 다르 두에 내려 달라고 하며 상대가 다르 두를 모른다고 놀리고, 그것을 보니 상대가 이 지역 출신이 아니라고 말해요.

latin: astghr allh . 3lah rak tkhshsh bia khwia ? fwt 3la tri9 kbira kima ghashi . i3shi shal9 bia wak ntwma ma fikwmsh laman bndam wla ikhaf 3la rw7h . win raki rai7a khti ? la khwia ma tl3 m3aia 7ta w7da almrd rah ma khsnash t9r9ish . diri baft ta3k w sahl .
english: The speaker says ‘Astaghfirullah’, asks why the listener is dragging them around, tells them to take a main road, and complains that people have no safety. A second exchange asks where the sister is going, rejects the idea that a woman came along, mentions illness, and ends with an opaque instruction about a ‘baft’.
korean: 화자는 ‘아스타그피룰라’라고 말하고 왜 자신을 끌고 다니느냐고 물으며 큰길로 가라고 해요. 사람들이 안전하지 않다고 불평한 뒤, 누이가 어디로 가는지 묻고 여성이 함께 오지 않았다고 하며 아픈 상황을 말하고 불투명한 ‘baft’ 지시로 끝나요.

latin: raha fw9 rask khti . maknsh alli insa m3akm saii 7tni ghir hna . hak . allh ikhlf w alf ki sralha . alh i7fz w istr t3lmtwa ts9rwa 3la alsrf . tdiha alkhla w aldra .
english: The speaker says the matter is over the sister’s head, asks to be left there, gives thanks, invokes protection, and jokes that the others have learned to bargain over money before taking it to the countryside; several surfaces are opaque.
korean: 화자는 일이 누이의 머리 위에 있다고 말하고 그곳에 내려 달라고 해요. 감사와 보호를 말한 뒤 사람들이 돈을 흥정하는 법을 배웠다고 농담하고 그것을 시골로 가져간다고 해요. 여러 표면은 불투명해요.

latin: ki tdkhli ll7bs m3 s7btk .
english: The line refers to entering prison with a friend; it is an incomplete, context-dependent remark.
korean: 친구와 함께 감옥에 들어가는 상황을 말하는 불완전하고 맥락 의존적인 발화예요.

latin: ma nsm3sh 7skm . j3t kwn ghir ma tjibli mbss fl9fa . tfwa mrhwja 3la jalk basit mn nhar alli 3rftk ma sht khir . iak ia d7s jbdtlk bwsb3a w 9ltlk 9isih m3aia flwad bsif nti brw7k knti ghir 3la sba ghi 3ittlk jiti tjri .
english: The speaker says ‘I cannot hear your voices’; says ‘I am hungry’; asks for the opaque food ‘mbss’ in a bag; says ‘what a disgrace because of you’; says ‘since the day I knew you I have seen no good’; addresses the opaque name-like ‘D7s’; says ‘I pulled Bousbaa for you and told you to measure it with me in the river’; says the addressee was alone and had only come for a reason kept opaque; and says ‘I called you and you came running’. Canonical surface sequence: `ma nsm3sh 7skm . j3t kwn ghir ma tjibli mbss fl9fa . tfwa mrhwja 3la jalk basit mn nhar alli 3rftk ma sht khir . iak ia d7s jbdtlk bwsb3a w 9ltlk 9isih m3aia flwad bsif nti brw7k knti ghir 3la sba ghi 3ittlk jiti tjri .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘너희 목소리가 안 들려’, ‘배고파’라고 하고 봉지에 든 불투명한 음식 ‘mbss’를 달라고 해요. ‘너 때문에 정말 엉망이야’, ‘너를 안 날부터 좋은 일을 본 적이 없어’라고 하고 불투명한 이름 같은 ‘D7s’를 부른 뒤 ‘Bousbaa를 데려와 강에서 나와 함께 재라고 했어’라고 해요. 상대가 혼자 어떤 이유로 있었던 부분은 열어 두고 ‘내가 불렀더니 네가 달려왔어’라고 마무리해요. canonical 표면 순서: `ma nsm3sh 7skm . j3t kwn ghir ma tjibli mbss fl9fa . tfwa mrhwja 3la jalk basit mn nhar alli 3rftk ma sht khir . iak ia d7s jbdtlk bwsb3a w 9ltlk 9isih m3aia flwad bsif nti brw7k knti ghir 3la sba ghi 3ittlk jiti tjri .`.

latin: bl3i bl3i fmk nti brw7k 7rkia kwn ma zfitinish 3nd jij kwn ma ranish hna . nti ktltih w ana r7t fi jra w mashi ana alli ktlth ana ki 3awntk t9isih flwad kan m9ndl .
english: The speaker repeats ‘shut your mouth’; directly insults the addressee as ‘you, by yourself, moving/acting’; says ‘if you had not sent me to the opaque place “jij”, I would not be here’; says ‘you killed him’; ‘I went in a mess’; ‘I was not the one who killed him’; and ‘I only helped you measure him in the river’, leaving ‘jra’ and ‘m9ndl’ source-close. Canonical surface sequence: `bl3i bl3i fmk nti brw7k 7rkia kwn ma zfitinish 3nd jij kwn ma ranish hna . nti ktltih w ana r7t fi jra w mashi ana alli ktlth ana ki 3awntk t9isih flwad kan m9ndl .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘입을 다물어’라고 반복하고 상대를 ‘너 혼자서 움직이는 사람’이라고 직접 모욕해요. ‘네가 나를 불투명한 장소 “jij”로 보내지 않았다면 나는 여기 없었어’, ‘네가 그를 죽였어’, ‘나는 엉켜서 갔어’, ‘그를 죽인 건 내가 아니야’, ‘나는 네가 강에서 그를 재는 것만 도왔어’라고 하며 ‘jra’와 ‘m9ndl’은 원문에 가깝게 둬요. canonical 표면 순서: `bl3i bl3i fmk nti brw7k 7rkia kwn ma zfitinish 3nd jij kwn ma ranish hna . nti ktltih w ana r7t fi jra w mashi ana alli ktlth ana ki 3awntk t9isih flwad kan m9ndl .`.

latin: baghi ndkhl w7di awmwan ntraf9wa w twnsini shwia . ia 7ti twnsi w7dk 7asbtni mtlw9a kifk wa9il ana ada ma ktlwnish fl7bs iktlni khwia nhar alli ikhrj .
english: The speaker wants to enter alone, asks the addressee to accompany and entertain them a little, says ‘at least’, asks whether the addressee thought the speaker was a released/free woman like them, and says that prison or the brother may kill the speaker when he gets out. Canonical surface sequence: `baghi ndkhl w7di awmwan ntraf9wa w twnsini shwia . ia 7ti twnsi w7dk 7asbtni mtlw9a kifk wa9il ana ada ma ktlwnish fl7bs iktlni khwia nhar alli ikhrj .`.
korean: 화자는 혼자 들어가고 싶지만 상대에게 동행해 조금 즐겁게 해 달라고 해요. ‘적어도’라고 하고 상대가 자신을 상대처럼 풀려난·자유로운 여자로 생각했느냐고 묻고, 감옥이나 형제가 출소할 때 자신을 죽일 수 있다고 말해요. canonical 표면 순서: `baghi ndkhl w7di awmwan ntraf9wa w twnsini shwia . ia 7ti twnsi w7dk 7asbtni mtlw9a kifk wa9il ana ada ma ktlwnish fl7bs iktlni khwia nhar alli ikhrj .`.

latin: aai ntwma bl3wh rakm hna fi zwj d9ai9 djjtwna . aai akhti w allh ala ghaia arwa7i khitili fmi ma ndabzsh m3 s7bti .
english: The speaker says the listeners exhausted them in two minutes, calls to the sister, and asks her to stitch or close the speaker’s mouth so the speaker will not fight with the friend; the surface is partly opaque.
korean: 화자는 일행이 2분 만에 자신을 지치게 했다고 하고 누이를 부르며, 친구와 다투지 않도록 자신의 입을 꿰매거나 닫아 달라고 해요. 일부 표면은 불투명해요.

latin: aai 3labalk win raki hnaia . tiri 3liha mwjilali . arwa7i tiri 3lia mwljilali . alli bgha dm , i9dm mzia jit , awmbiws shaba rahi hna mn alsh3r .
english: The speaker asks ‘do you know where you are now?’; tells the opaque name-like person to fly away; calls the person again; says whoever wants blood should come; says ‘I came well/right’; and keeps the final praise-like expression about beauty and hair source-close. Canonical surface sequence: `aai 3labalk win raki hnaia . tiri 3liha mwjilali . arwa7i tiri 3lia mwljilali . alli bgha dm , i9dm mzia jit , awmbiws shaba rahi hna mn alsh3r .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘네가 지금 어디 있는지 알아?’라고 묻고 불투명한 이름 같은 상대에게 날아가라고 해요. 다시 부르고 ‘피를 원하는 사람은 오라’고 하며 ‘내가 잘 왔어/오길 잘했어’라고 하고 마지막 아름다움과 머리카락을 칭찬하는 듯한 표현은 원문에 가깝게 둬요. canonical 표면 순서: `aai 3labalk win raki hnaia . tiri 3liha mwjilali . arwa7i tiri 3lia mwljilali . alli bgha dm , i9dm mzia jit , awmbiws shaba rahi hna mn alsh3r .`.

latin: hadik li tkhdm fi lamiri ki tdkhl ldarha .
english: The speaker describes the woman who works at the town hall when she enters her home; it is a short incomplete comparison.
korean: 화자가 시청에서 일하는 여성이 집에 들어갈 때를 묘사하는 짧고 불완전한 비교예요.

latin: mama 3ndki . ma ti7lish w 7mar . aai asm3wa rasi rah baghi itrt9 . wlwa mnb3d khima nsr3 wa7d fikm .
english: The speaker warns the mother not to fall and calls someone a donkey, says their head is about to burst, and threatens to knock one of them out later; the comic threats are retained without literal escalation.
korean: 화자는 엄마에게 넘어지지 말라고 하고 누군가를 당나귀라고 부르며 머리가 터질 것 같다고 해요. 나중에 일행 중 한 명을 쓰러뜨리겠다고 농담해요.

latin: mama n9d nrw7 m3 aimn lstad . m3lblish , shwf m3 shaf srfis rani nt9hwa . m3 mn ? m3 bwk .
english: The speaker asks mother about going with Aymen to the stadium; says ‘I don’t know’; says ‘check with the service chief—I am drinking coffee’; asks ‘with whom?’; and answers ‘with your father’. Canonical surface sequence: `mama n9d nrw7 m3 aimn lstad . m3lblish , shwf m3 shaf srfis rani nt9hwa . m3 mn ? m3 bwk .`.
korean: 화자는 엄마에게 아이만과 경기장에 가도 되는지 묻고 ‘모르겠어’라고 해요. ‘서비스 책임자에게 확인해, 나는 커피를 마시는 중이야’라고 하고 ‘누구와?’라고 묻자 ‘네 아버지와’라고 답해요. canonical 표면 순서: `mama n9d nrw7 m3 aimn lstad . m3lblish , shwf m3 shaf srfis rani nt9hwa . m3 mn ? m3 bwk .`.

latin: ma nti 9a3 3am mshnfa , mt aimn 3ndha al79 9altli mk mn 3am da9iws ma d7ktsh .
english: The speaker says the listener has been sulky all year; says Aymen’s mother is right; and reports that the listener’s mother told the speaker that the listener had not laughed for the opaque time expression. The two mothers and the report are kept distinct. Canonical surface sequence: `ma nti 9a3 3am mshnfa , mt aimn 3ndha al79 9altli mk mn 3am da9iws ma d7ktsh .`.
korean: 화자는 상대가 1년 내내 시무룩하다고 하고 아이만의 어머니가 맞다고 해요. 이어 상대의 어머니가 불투명한 기간 동안 상대가 웃지 않았다고 자신에게 말했다고 전해요. 두 어머니와 전언을 구분해요. canonical 표면 순서: `ma nti 9a3 3am mshnfa , mt aimn 3ndha al79 9altli mk mn 3am da9iws ma d7ktsh .`.

latin: 9wlha rw7i 3si rajlk alli ja 39d 3la zawja liwm ia shtba . jaia t3sni anaia .
english: The speaker tells someone to go watch the husband who came today to propose marriage, then jokes that the woman has come to watch the speaker instead.
korean: 화자는 오늘 청혼하러 온 남편을 지켜보러 가라고 하고, 그 여성이 오히려 자신을 지켜보러 왔다고 농담해요.

latin: t7zn 3lia ma tzid thdr nwrilha .
english: The speaker asks for sympathy, says ‘do not talk any more’, and says ‘I will show her’, leaving what will be shown unresolved. Canonical surface sequence: `t7zn 3lia ma tzid thdr nwrilha .`.
korean: 화자는 자신을 불쌍히 여겨 달라고 하고 ‘더 말하지 마’라고 한 뒤 ‘내가 그녀에게 보여 줄게’라고 해요. 무엇을 보여 주는지는 미확정으로 둬요. canonical 표면 순서: `t7zn 3lia ma tzid thdr nwrilha .`.

latin: ma dirinash 3sha ntia . kikwta ma rahsh tkhdm khwia , ma ndirsh , rani kwnji , wla rw7 3nd sba7 alkhir jarti ki sb7ti ? dirlk 3sha , wli ghdwa .
english: The speaker asks or tells the female addressee about dinner; says the pressure cooker is not working; says ‘I will not do it’ and ‘I am on leave’; tells the listener to go to the neighbour with the greeting ‘good morning, neighbour, how did you wake up?’; says ‘make yourself dinner’; and says ‘come back tomorrow’. Canonical surface sequence: `ma dirinash 3sha ntia . kikwta ma rahsh tkhdm khwia , ma ndirsh , rani kwnji , wla rw7 3nd sba7 alkhir jarti ki sb7ti ? dirlk 3sha , wli ghdwa .`.
korean: 화자는 여성 청자에게 저녁을 묻거나 요구하고 압력솥이 작동하지 않는다고 해요. ‘나는 안 할 거야’, ‘휴가 중이야’라고 하고 이웃에게 가서 ‘좋은 아침, 이웃아. 잘 잤어?’라고 인사하라고 해요. ‘저녁을 만들어 먹고 내일 다시 와’라고 해요. canonical 표면 순서: `ma dirinash 3sha ntia . kikwta ma rahsh tkhdm khwia , ma ndirsh , rani kwnji , wla rw7 3nd sba7 alkhir jarti ki sb7ti ? dirlk 3sha , wli ghdwa .`.

latin: anwa3 alshirat fi lafak hadik alli jaia dbr rajl bash ttzwj .
english: The speaker mentions types of girls in ‘lafak’, including the one who comes to find a husband in order to marry; the place or surface name is kept source-close.
korean: 화자는 ‘lafak’에 있는 여자들의 유형을 말하며, 결혼할 남편을 찾으러 오는 여성을 언급해요. 장소나 표면 이름은 원문에 가깝게 보존해요.

latin: slam khwia . win idsrwa lizaskrbsiwn 7mbwk ? awfas . s7a .
english: The speaker greets the brother and asks where the registrations are done, receiving an opaque place-name answer; the greeting exchange is preserved.
korean: 화자는 형제에게 인사하고 등록을 어디에서 하는지 묻으며 불투명한 장소 이름의 답을 들어요. 인사 turn을 보존해요.

latin: baghi ns9sik rjal win ijm3wa ? sl3a jhd bs7 mashi bti . win ijm3wa ?
english: The speaker asks where the men gather, says the goods are strong but not cheap, and repeats the question about where they gather; the market vocabulary is source-close.
korean: 화자는 남자들이 어디에 모이는지 묻고 물건이 튼튼하지만 싸지는 않다고 말한 뒤 어디에 모이는지 다시 물어요. 시장 어휘는 원문에 가깝게 보존해요.

latin: almkrasha : sha bghit n9wlk nrw7wa 3shia 3nd mstfa nftrwa , bs7 raha 3ad 8 .
english: Keeping only the opaque title-like opening, the speaker proposes ‘let us go this evening to Mustafa’s place and eat/break the fast’; the meal surface is not narrowed to breakfast. Canonical surface sequence: `almkrasha : sha bghit n9wlk nrw7wa 3shia 3nd mstfa nftrwa , bs7 raha 3ad 8 .`.
korean: 불투명한 제목 같은 초두만 원문에 가깝게 두고 화자는 ‘오늘 저녁 무스타파에게 가서 먹자/금식을 깨자’고 제안해요. 식사 표면을 아침 식사로 좁히지 않아요. canonical 표면 순서: `almkrasha : sha bghit n9wlk nrw7wa 3shia 3nd mstfa nftrwa , bs7 raha 3ad 8 .`.

latin: wah khti j3t ma 9ditsh rkz w ana krshi khawia allh i7fz w istr sha tbl3 .
english: The speaker says they are hungry, cannot concentrate, and have an empty stomach; invokes ‘may God protect and shelter us’; and asks ‘what is there to eat or swallow?’ Canonical surface sequence: `wah khti j3t ma 9ditsh rkz w ana krshi khawia allh i7fz w istr sha tbl3 .`.
korean: 화자는 배가 고프고 집중할 수 없으며 배가 비었다고 해요. ‘신이 보호하고 지켜 주시길’이라고 축원하고 ‘뭘 먹어/삼켜?’라고 물어요. canonical 표면 순서: `wah khti j3t ma 9ditsh rkz w ana krshi khawia allh i7fz w istr sha tbl3 .`.

latin: li 3la 3am w hi mdabza m3 sa7bha , ia m3ad tl9ni 7mbwk w allh hw hdr m3aia ana sha dkhlni , 3ndk ghadi tzr9ni . tl9ni 7mbwk . ki dair ghiar .
english: The speaker says a woman has been arguing with her partner for a year; calls out ‘hey, release me, please’; says the partner spoke to the speaker and asks what that has to do with the speaker; says ‘you are going to hit/shout at me’ in the source-close threat; repeats ‘release me’; and ends by commenting on how intense the jealousy is. Canonical surface sequence: `li 3la 3am w hi mdabza m3 sa7bha , ia m3ad tl9ni 7mbwk w allh hw hdr m3aia ana sha dkhlni , 3ndk ghadi tzr9ni . tl9ni 7mbwk . ki dair ghiar .`.
korean: 화자는 한 여성이 1년 동안 연인과 다투고 있다고 해요. ‘이봐, 제발 나를 놓아 줘’라고 부르고, 그 연인이 자신에게 말했다며 ‘그게 나와 무슨 상관이야?’라고 해요. 원문의 때리거나 소리치는 위협을 보존하고 ‘제발 나를 놓아 줘’를 반복한 뒤 질투가 얼마나 심한지 말하며 끝내요. canonical 표면 순서: `li 3la 3am w hi mdabza m3 sa7bha , ia m3ad tl9ni 7mbwk w allh hw hdr m3aia ana sha dkhlni , 3ndk ghadi tzr9ni . tl9ni 7mbwk . ki dair ghiar .`.

latin: li t9ra ghir alkwr lwl w tkhrj . astad . wi fm klb hdri brki ma t3wji fi rw7k . n9d nrw7 lisanitr ?
english: The speaker says someone studies only the first course and leaves; says ‘teacher’; directly insults them with ‘dog mouth’; warns ‘speak, perhaps do not twist yourself’; and asks ‘can I go to the restroom/sanitary place?’ Canonical surface sequence: `li t9ra ghir alkwr lwl w tkhrj . astad . wi fm klb hdri brki ma t3wji fi rw7k . n9d nrw7 lisanitr ?`.
korean: 화자는 누군가가 첫 과정만 공부하고 나간다고 하고 ‘선생님’이라고 해요. ‘개 같은 입’이라는 직접 모욕을 하고 ‘말해, 네 몸을 꼬지 않도록 해’라고 경고한 뒤 ‘화장실에 가도 돼?’라고 물어요. canonical 표면 순서: `li t9ra ghir alkwr lwl w tkhrj . astad . wi fm klb hdri brki ma t3wji fi rw7k . n9d nrw7 lisanitr ?`.

latin: li t9ra li lwn9 . fwzia sha raki daira liwm . m3labalish , rahm dairin lwbia . sha raki la3btha lna fwzia .
english: The speaker mentions someone who studies only the long course, asks Fouzia what she is doing today, hears that they are making beans, and asks what she is pretending to be for them.
korean: 화자는 긴 과정만 공부하는 사람을 언급하고 푸지아에게 오늘 무엇을 하는지 물어요. 콩을 만들고 있다는 답을 듣고 무엇인 척하는지 다시 물어요.

latin: kwn jaw alshirat fi blasa ma ikdbwa i9wlwa als7 . shrit hadi tani iadra .
english: The speaker says that if the girls were in the place of the ones who lie, they would tell the truth, and says they bought this one too; the comparison is opaque.
korean: 화자는 여자들이 거짓말하는 사람들의 자리에 있다면 진실을 말할 것이라고 하고 이것도 샀다고 말해요. 비교의 대상은 불투명해요.

latin: sh3al shritiha ? shritha mliwn w ma 9ash7thash . had shrmita w raki thdri 3liha . sha hadi ma nshrwsh , ma nlbswsh , ma nstahlwsh , ma shi bniadm 7na . baghi ndir sa7b ghir bd3wa alkhir .
english: The speaker asks the price; says the item cost a million; says ‘I did not like it’; directly calls it ‘that whore/bitch’; says ‘we will not buy it, wear it, or deserve it’; says ‘we are not human’; and says they want to make a friend through a good-wish phrase. Canonical surface sequence: `sh3al shritiha ? shritha mliwn w ma 9ash7thash . had shrmita w raki thdri 3liha . sha hadi ma nshrwsh , ma nlbswsh , ma nstahlwsh , ma shi bniadm 7na . baghi ndir sa7b ghir bd3wa alkhir .`.
korean: 화자는 가격을 묻고 백만에 샀다고 하며 ‘마음에 들지 않았어’라고 해요. 물건을 직접 욕하고 ‘우리는 사지도 입지도 그럴 자격도 없어’, ‘우리는 인간도 아니야’라고 한 뒤 좋은 말로 친구를 만들고 싶다고 해요. canonical 표면 순서: `sh3al shritiha ? shritha mliwn w ma 9ash7thash . had shrmita w raki thdri 3liha . sha hadi ma nshrwsh , ma nlbswsh , ma nstahlwsh , ma shi bniadm 7na . baghi ndir sa7b ghir bd3wa alkhir .`.

latin: baba bs7 tinisa rak darbha kima t3 li knt nkhrj m3ah . shwala ? malk takl fi rw7k kmlna . z3ma 93d i3itli bash nwlwa bs7 saii si fini ma nkhdmsh 9lit . drwk ghir aibiza w tl3 .
english: The speaker addresses father; keeps ‘tinisa’ as a tennis/sneakers-like surface; compares it with someone they used to go out with; asks ‘what?’; says ‘why are you eating yourself?’; says someone kept calling to return; says ‘enough, it’s finished, I do not work as the opaque job surface’; and ends with the Ibiza surface and ‘go up/leave’. Canonical surface sequence: `baba bs7 tinisa rak darbha kima t3 li knt nkhrj m3ah . shwala ? malk takl fi rw7k kmlna . z3ma 93d i3itli bash nwlwa bs7 saii si fini ma nkhdmsh 9lit . drwk ghir aibiza w tl3 .`.
korean: 화자는 아버지를 부르고 ‘tinisa’를 테니스화·운동화 같은 표면으로 두며 예전에 함께 다니던 사람과 비교해요. ‘뭐라고?’라고 묻고 ‘왜 너 자신을 갉아먹어?’라고 해요. 돌아오라고 계속 불렀던 일을 말하고 ‘됐어, 끝났어. 나는 그 불투명한 일은 안 해’라고 한 뒤 이비자 표면과 ‘올라가/나가’로 끝내요. canonical 표면 순서: `baba bs7 tinisa rak darbha kima t3 li knt nkhrj m3ah . shwala ? malk takl fi rw7k kmlna . z3ma 93d i3itli bash nwlwa bs7 saii si fini ma nkhdmsh 9lit . drwk ghir aibiza w tl3 .`.

latin: jinakm b7sb w nsb . al7sb w alnsb jibwh m3ah awmwa bwki t3 wrd . dija mbkrin li ana , nas tji tkhtb li 3la 10 t3 alsba7 ghadi nhrb . w nta mashi 9tlk lbs 9mja nhar alli tji tkhtbni .
english: The speaker says they came with lineage and asks for the lineage to be brought with a rose bouquet. They joke that people who come to propose at ten in the morning will make the speaker run, and remind the listener to wear a shirt when coming to propose.
korean: 화자는 혈통과 신분을 갖추고 왔다고 하며 장미 꽃다발과 함께 그 혈통을 가져오라고 해요. 오전 10시에 청혼하러 오는 사람들을 보면 도망가겠다고 농담하고 청혼하러 올 때 셔츠를 입으라고 상기시켜요.

latin: sha raki thdri t3rfih ? n3rfh wah , 5 snsn w ana taiba m3ah wjh almiziria hada .
english: The speaker asks whether the listener knows him, answers yes, and says they have been involved with him for five years, calling him a face of misery; the idiom is preserved as a joke.
korean: 화자는 상대가 그 남자를 아느냐고 묻고 안다고 답하며 5년 동안 그와 얽혀 있었다고 해요. 그를 불행의 얼굴이라고 부르는 표현은 농담으로 보존해요.

latin: dija hadi hi mk tban msfara ma nsknsh m3aha hadi , diri dari w7di n9wlha lk 9damha .
english: The speaker says the woman looks yellow/pale; says ‘I will not live with her’; says ‘make/arrange a separate home for me’; and says ‘I will tell you in front of her’. The addressee and the woman remain distinct. Canonical surface sequence: `dija hadi hi mk tban msfara ma nsknsh m3aha hadi , diri dari w7di n9wlha lk 9damha .`.
korean: 화자는 그 여성이 누렇거나 창백해 보인다고 하고 ‘나는 그녀와 살지 않을 거야’라고 해요. ‘내가 따로 살 집을 마련해 줘’라고 하고 ‘그녀 앞에서 너에게 말할 거야’라고 해 상대와 여성을 구분해요. canonical 표면 순서: `dija hadi hi mk tban msfara ma nsknsh m3aha hadi , diri dari w7di n9wlha lk 9damha .`.

latin: s7btk kwn jat kiasa t3 al7mam . 3lah raki tswri fia khti ? 3la mn raki ia fkrwna . shti kmartk . haila mraia ada ma zal ma shftish rw7k nkhli 9a3 3bad rbi w nji nswrk ntia . sha ndir bik 7mbwk .
english: The speaker compares the friend with a hammam scrubber/attendant; asks why the sister is photographing the speaker; calls the addressee a turtle; says ‘look at your face’; says ‘what a mirror’; says they will leave everyone and come photograph the listener; and asks ‘what shall I do with you?’ Canonical surface sequence: `s7btk kwn jat kiasa t3 al7mam . 3lah raki tswri fia khti ? 3la mn raki ia fkrwna . shti kmartk . haila mraia ada ma zal ma shftish rw7k nkhli 9a3 3bad rbi w nji nswrk ntia . sha ndir bik 7mbwk .`.
korean: 화자는 친구를 목욕탕 때밀이·관리인에 비유하고 누이가 왜 자신을 찍는지 물어요. 상대를 거북이라고 부르고 ‘네 얼굴을 봐’, ‘거울이네’라고 놀려요. 모두를 두고 와서 상대를 찍겠다고 한 뒤 ‘너를 어떻게 해야 하지?’라고 반문해요. canonical 표면 순서: `s7btk kwn jat kiasa t3 al7mam . 3lah raki tswri fia khti ? 3la mn raki ia fkrwna . shti kmartk . haila mraia ada ma zal ma shftish rw7k nkhli 9a3 3bad rbi w nji nswrk ntia . sha ndir bik 7mbwk .`.

latin: 3nddha 3lah tkhaf khti mrt khwia darwha fi 9rwb t3 alm3lmat almtl9at fi al7mam .
english: The speaker asks why the sister is afraid; says ‘my brother’s wife’; says ‘they put her in the group of divorced female teachers at the hammam’; and keeps the plural actor in ‘they put her’. Canonical surface sequence: `3nddha 3lah tkhaf khti mrt khwia darwha fi 9rwb t3 alm3lmat almtl9at fi al7mam .`.
korean: 화자는 누이가 왜 무서워하는지 묻고 ‘내 형제의 아내’를 말해요. ‘그들이 그녀를 목욕탕의 이혼한 여성 교사들 그룹에 넣었어’라고 하며 복수 행위자를 보존해요. canonical 표면 순서: `3nddha 3lah tkhaf khti mrt khwia darwha fi 9rwb t3 alm3lmat almtl9at fi al7mam .`.

latin: w nti sha nt9k ? la arwa7wa t7amwa fia aia khti alli ma 3jbhash al7al trw7 dwsh fi darha .
english: The speaker asks what the other person is saying, invites everyone to bathe them, and says anyone who is unhappy can go shower at home.
korean: 화자는 상대가 무슨 말을 하는지 묻고 모두에게 자신을 씻겨 달라고 해요. 마음에 들지 않는 사람은 집에서 샤워하러 가라고 해요.

latin: khti hada ghir zhr sa3a w ana n7k fik frktk nti nkhls 3lik balmtr almrb3 . la khti kiasa lkhra tkhls 3lia ghir khmslaf . wi tl9wni ghadi ntrt9 fwta w ntir 3liha .
english: The speaker says the other hammam scrubber charges the speaker five thousand; says ‘they are going to make me burst and I will fly at her’ in the comic threat surface; and keeps the one-hour scratching and square-metre payment turns. Canonical surface sequence: `khti hada ghir zhr sa3a w ana n7k fik frktk nti nkhls 3lik balmtr almrb3 . la khti kiasa lkhra tkhls 3lia ghir khmslaf . wi tl9wni ghadi ntrt9 fwta w ntir 3liha .`.
korean: 화자는 다른 목욕탕 때밀이가 자신에게 5천을 받는다고 해요. ‘나를 터뜨리려 하니 내가 그녀에게 달려들 거야’라는 코믹한 위협 표면을 보존하고 한 시간 동안 긁어 주기와 제곱미터 금액 turn도 유지해요. canonical 표면 순서: `khti hada ghir zhr sa3a w ana n7k fik frktk nti nkhls 3lik balmtr almrb3 . la khti kiasa lkhra tkhls 3lia ghir khmslaf . wi tl9wni ghadi ntrt9 fwta w ntir 3liha .`.

latin: khmslaf rani ntlb 3lik khti . ghadi aldwd alli khrjth lk nwklh lk . rani n9wlk . khti hada raki mdkhlath m3ah . wah mskin wldi sghir hada . sha sghrh khti hada rah 3r3wr shlaghmh tktfi bihm jml .
english: The speaker asks for five thousand; says ‘I will feed you the worms I pulled out’; repeats the address; says the addressee has brought in a small boy; and says the boy’s moustache/body surface is enough for a camel, keeping only the remaining ‘3r3wr’ opaque if needed. Canonical surface sequence: `khmslaf rani ntlb 3lik khti . ghadi aldwd alli khrjth lk nwklh lk . rani n9wlk . khti hada raki mdkhlath m3ah . wah mskin wldi sghir hada . sha sghrh khti hada rah 3r3wr shlaghmh tktfi bihm jml .`.
korean: 화자는 5천을 요구하고 ‘내가 꺼낸 벌레들을 너에게 먹일 거야’라고 해요. 상대를 다시 부르고 작은 소년을 데려왔다고 하며 그 소년의 콧수염·신체 표면이 낙대에게 충분하다고 코믹하게 말해요. 남은 ‘3r3wr’만 필요하면 불투명하게 둬요. canonical 표면 순서: `khmslaf rani ntlb 3lik khti . ghadi aldwd alli khrjth lk nwklh lk . rani n9wlk . khti hada raki mdkhlath m3ah . wah mskin wldi sghir hada . sha sghrh khti hada rah 3r3wr shlaghmh tktfi bihm jml .`.

latin: ghir i9r3lk hna khti hada ghtdi dkhlih li ihrbli 9a3 nsa t3 al7mam .
english: The speaker says ‘if he only knocks here, bring him inside’; says he will make all the women of the hammam run away; and keeps the masculine object and direct comic threat. Canonical surface sequence: `ghir i9r3lk hna khti hada ghtdi dkhlih li ihrbli 9a3 nsa t3 al7mam .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘그가 여기서 노크만 하면 그를 안으로 들여보내’라고 하고 ‘그가 목욕탕 여자들을 전부 도망가게 할 거야’라고 해요. 남성 목적어와 직접적인 코믹 위협을 보존해요. canonical 표면 순서: `ghir i9r3lk hna khti hada ghtdi dkhlih li ihrbli 9a3 nsa t3 al7mam .`.

latin: s7btk kwn jat awtas dw lagh : bwnjwgh . inwdwni drwk . hadwa irw7wa lfrnsa 3la 5 t3 sba7 ghadi thrb . ki sb7ti zhra . ki rak baghini nsb7 7mbwk . l79ni klb brhwsh sba7 ki khrjt ana njri w hw inb7 . khwia hada 3rajin t3 altmr 9a3 rak mtl3hm m3ak . kwn 9l3t alnkhl t3 awtwrwt w jlthm m3ak w saii ala ma rahmsh iwklwk fi frwnsa 93dwa fi bladkm .
english: The speaker keeps the air-hostess/bonjour greeting; says ‘they will wake me now’; says people are going to France at five in the morning and someone will run away; asks how Zahra woke; says ‘how do you want me to greet you?’; recalls the barking dog; mentions date bunches; jokes about uprooting palms for the road; and says if France will not feed them they should stay in their own country. Canonical surface sequence: `s7btk kwn jat awtas dw lagh : bwnjwgh . inwdwni drwk . hadwa irw7wa lfrnsa 3la 5 t3 sba7 ghadi thrb . ki sb7ti zhra . ki rak baghini nsb7 7mbwk . l79ni klb brhwsh sba7 ki khrjt ana njri w hw inb7 . khwia hada 3rajin t3 altmr 9a3 rak mtl3hm m3ak . kwn 9l3t alnkhl t3 awtwrwt w jlthm m3ak w saii ala ma rahmsh iwklwk fi frwnsa 93dwa fi bladkm .`.
korean: 화자는 항공 승무원·bonjour 인사를 보존하고 ‘그들이 이제 나를 깨울 거야’라고 해요. 사람들이 새벽 5시에 프랑스로 가고 누군가는 도망갈 거라고 하며 자흐라가 어떻게 일어났는지 묻고 ‘내가 너에게 어떻게 인사하길 바라?’라고 해요. 짖는 개를 떠올리고 대추야자 송이와 도로의 야자나무를 말한 뒤 프랑스가 먹여 살리지 않으면 자기 나라에 남으라고 해요. canonical 표면 순서: `s7btk kwn jat awtas dw lagh : bwnjwgh . inwdwni drwk . hadwa irw7wa lfrnsa 3la 5 t3 sba7 ghadi thrb . ki sb7ti zhra . ki rak baghini nsb7 7mbwk . l79ni klb brhwsh sba7 ki khrjt ana njri w hw inb7 . khwia hada 3rajin t3 altmr 9a3 rak mtl3hm m3ak . kwn 9l3t alnkhl t3 awtwrwt w jlthm m3ak w saii ala ma rahmsh iwklwk fi frwnsa 93dwa fi bladkm .`.

latin: ia 3ndki hadi kiraha mshawjia baldhb 7ta zhrha 3waj . krim arwa7 hna . khwia raha 6 t3 sba7 shd krim ta3k , khima ndlih lk mn alta9a . wi alzin lakwb kari w nkhmm fik swnzari .
english: The speaker compares the woman’s appearance with gold and a crooked back; calls Karim; says it is six in the morning; tells Karim to come; keeps the square haircut surface; says the cup/beauty phrase; and says they think of the addressee continuously, with ‘swnzari’ translated toward without stopping. Canonical surface sequence: `ia 3ndki hadi kiraha mshawjia baldhb 7ta zhrha 3waj . krim arwa7 hna . khwia raha 6 t3 sba7 shd krim ta3k , khima ndlih lk mn alta9a . wi alzin lakwb kari w nkhmm fik swnzari .`.
korean: 화자는 여성의 외모를 금과 굽은 등에 비유하고 카림을 부르며 오전 6시라고 해요. 카림에게 오라고 하고 사각 헤어컷 표면과 컵·미모 표현을 보존하며 ‘swnzari’를 쉼 없이·계속 상대를 생각한다는 방향으로 번역해요. canonical 표면 순서: `ia 3ndki hadi kiraha mshawjia baldhb 7ta zhrha 3waj . krim arwa7 hna . khwia raha 6 t3 sba7 shd krim ta3k , khima ndlih lk mn alta9a . wi alzin lakwb kari w nkhmm fik swnzari .`.

latin: fi sma w ma slknash m3akm . allh i7fz w istr . khti baghi ns9sik m3lish . sha hw ? tiara hadi mti7sh . shft rwbwrtaj fi nasiwnal jiw9raf twswst . win t7si . 3lmi 3lmk khwia m3labalish 7ta bilwt w rah mtlms . bl3wa biban rw7 jm3 khwia rw7 w ma tnsash shhada h .
english: The speaker says they are in the sky; says they did not manage with the others; invokes protection; asks a question; says ‘what is it?’; says the plane will not fall; recalls a National Geographic report; says ‘I know as much as you/I do not know either’; says even the pilot is lost/confused; tells them to close the doors and leave; and says not to forget the shahada/profession of faith. Canonical surface sequence: `fi sma w ma slknash m3akm . allh i7fz w istr . khti baghi ns9sik m3lish . sha hw ? tiara hadi mti7sh . shft rwbwrtaj fi nasiwnal jiw9raf twswst . win t7si . 3lmi 3lmk khwia m3labalish 7ta bilwt w rah mtlms . bl3wa biban rw7 jm3 khwia rw7 w ma tnsash shhada h .`.
korean: 화자는 하늘에 있다고 하고 일행과 잘 맞지 않았다고 해요. 보호를 축원하고 질문하며 ‘그게 뭐야?’라고 하고 비행기는 떨어지지 않는다고 해요. 내셔널 지오그래픽 리포트를 떠올리고 ‘나도 너만큼 알아/나도 몰라’라고 하며 조종사조차 헤맨다고 해요. 문을 닫고 나가라고 한 뒤 샤하다·신앙고백을 잊지 말라고 해요. canonical 표면 순서: `fi sma w ma slknash m3akm . allh i7fz w istr . khti baghi ns9sik m3lish . sha hw ? tiara hadi mti7sh . shft rwbwrtaj fi nasiwnal jiw9raf twswst . win t7si . 3lmi 3lmk khwia m3labalish 7ta bilwt w rah mtlms . bl3wa biban rw7 jm3 khwia rw7 w ma tnsash shhada h .`.

latin: al3aila aljzairia al3zima ki tkwn ttfrj almatsh hdik li 7asba rw7ha f 2010 .
english: The speaker describes the great Algerian family watching the match and jokes about someone who thinks they are still in 2010.
korean: 화자는 위대한 알제리 가족이 경기를 보는 모습을 말하고 누군가가 아직도 2010년에 있다고 생각한다고 농담해요.

latin: ziani s9inw7 win rah ?
english: The speaker asks where Ziani is; the named footballer reference is kept without adding context.
korean: 화자는 지아니가 어디 있는지 물어요. 축구 선수 이름이라는 표면은 추가 맥락 없이 보존해요.

latin: raki 7asba rw7k f 2010 ma b9ash ziani ia 3mri ma i9dwsh ijibwh il3b ghir matsh haka . tw7shth .
english: The speaker says the listener thinks they are in 2010; says Ziani is no longer there; asks rhetorically whether they cannot bring him to play even one match; addresses ‘my dear’; and ends ‘I miss him’. Canonical surface sequence: `raki 7asba rw7k f 2010 ma b9ash ziani ia 3mri ma i9dwsh ijibwh il3b ghir matsh haka . tw7shth .`.
korean: 화자는 상대가 2010년에 있다고 생각한다고 하고 지아니는 더 이상 없다고 해요. 한 경기라도 뛰게 데려올 수 없느냐고 수사적으로 묻고 ‘내 사랑아’라고 부른 뒤 ‘그가 그리워’라고 끝내요. canonical 표면 순서: `raki 7asba rw7k f 2010 ma b9ash ziani ia 3mri ma i9dwsh ijibwh il3b ghir matsh haka . tw7shth .`.

latin: kr3in m3iz dir lh tibw kima haka mrki kwn rani ana kwn rani mrkit 7 .
english: The speaker jokes about goat legs, says to make him a tifo like this, and says that if the speaker were the one scoring, they would have scored seven; the football joke is source-close.
korean: 화자는 염소 다리라고 놀리며 그를 이런 식으로 응원 깃발로 만들라고 해요. 자신이 득점한 사람이라면 7골을 넣었을 거라고 농담해요.

latin: hadik alli jaia tk7l , ia ki shab wa7d kifah w mnzidsh . rah dair tatwwaj , tb3h .
english: The speaker describes the woman coming to apply kohl; exclaims ‘wow, how handsome he became—I will say no more’; says he has a tattoo; and says ‘follow him’. Canonical surface sequence: `hadik alli jaia tk7l , ia ki shab wa7d kifah w mnzidsh . rah dair tatwwaj , tb3h .`.
korean: 화자는 아이라인을 하러 오는 여성을 말하고 ‘와, 얼마나 멋져졌는지—더 말하지 않을게’라고 감탄해요. 그가 문신을 했다고 하고 ‘그를 따라가’라고 해요. canonical 표면 순서: `hadik alli jaia tk7l , ia ki shab wa7d kifah w mnzidsh . rah dair tatwwaj , tb3h .`.

latin: li itfrj 9lb w rb . rw7 ia iwnja7 rw7 . 3lah dirwli kima hak . 3lah rahm il3bwa z3ma kwb afrik di mwnd . bl3i fmk allh i7fzk kwn ghir hdrtk fiha faida 7mara .
english: The speaker addresses the watcher; tells the named/opaque person to go; asks why they are treating the speaker that way; compares it with playing the Africa World Cup; says ‘shut your mouth, may God protect you’; and says ‘if only your words had some use, you donkey’. Canonical surface sequence: `li itfrj 9lb w rb . rw7 ia iwnja7 rw7 . 3lah dirwli kima hak . 3lah rahm il3bwa z3ma kwb afrik di mwnd . bl3i fmk allh i7fzk kwn ghir hdrtk fiha faida 7mara .`.
korean: 화자는 지켜보는 사람을 부르고 이름·불투명 표면의 상대에게 가라고 해요. 왜 자신에게 그렇게 하느냐고 묻고 아프리카 월드컵을 하는 것 같다고 비교해요. ‘입을 다물어, 신이 너를 보호하시길’이라고 한 뒤 ‘네 말에 쓸모라도 있었으면 좋겠네, 이 당나귀야’라고 직접 욕해요. canonical 표면 순서: `li itfrj 9lb w rb . rw7 ia iwnja7 rw7 . 3lah dirwli kima hak . 3lah rahm il3bwa z3ma kwb afrik di mwnd . bl3i fmk allh i7fzk kwn ghir hdrtk fiha faida 7mara .`.

latin: wah hwma irb7wa fdrahm w ntwma 93dwa madbzin li 3lihm hna . nwdi nti n9ili btata , 9a3dtli mjm3a li m3 traris .
english: The speaker says the others make money while the listeners argue about them; tells the woman to get up and clean potatoes; and says she is sitting gathered with the guys/men. The accusation and the guys direction are direct. Canonical surface sequence: `wah hwma irb7wa fdrahm w ntwma 93dwa madbzin li 3lihm hna . nwdi nti n9ili btata , 9a3dtli mjm3a li m3 traris .`.
korean: 화자는 다른 사람들은 돈을 버는데 일행은 그들 때문에 다툰다고 해요. 여성에게 일어나 감자를 손질하라고 하고 그녀가 남자들·녀석들과 모여 앉아 있다고 말해요. 비난과 남자들 방향을 직접 번역해요. canonical 표면 순서: `wah hwma irb7wa fdrahm w ntwma 93dwa madbzin li 3lihm hna . nwdi nti n9ili btata , 9a3dtli mjm3a li m3 traris .`.

latin: nb3 al7nan ki tkhrj tshri m3 bntha : 3am bash tkhrji li 3rwsa nti . ana nlbs sbati w nkhrj ma n9ar3sh . khatsh ndir 3lik ntia 7ta al3sha' ndkhl ldari . baghi 7ta i9wlwa manish 3arfa win kant haima hi w bntha fi ns liali . mama ndi hadi w la hadi .
english: The speaker says ‘the source of tenderness’ goes shopping with her daughter; says ‘a year for you to make her a bride’; says ‘I put on my shoes and leave—I do not wait’; says they will keep watch until dinner and return home; asks whether the speaker is meant to hear where the mother and daughter wandered at midnight; and asks mother which item to take. Canonical surface sequence: `nb3 al7nan ki tkhrj tshri m3 bntha : 3am bash tkhrji li 3rwsa nti . ana nlbs sbati w nkhrj ma n9ar3sh . khatsh ndir 3lik ntia 7ta al3sha' ndkhl ldari . baghi 7ta i9wlwa manish 3arfa win kant haima hi w bntha fi ns liali . mama ndi hadi w la hadi .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘다정함의 샘’이 딸과 쇼핑하러 간다고 해요. ‘네가 그녀를 신부로 만드는 데 1년이 걸려’라고 하고 ‘나는 신발을 신고 나가, 기다리지 않아’라고 해요. 저녁까지 지켜보다 집에 들어간다고 하며 엄마와 딸이 한밤중에 어디를 돌아다녔는지 듣게 하려는 거냐고 묻고 엄마에게 어느 물건을 가져갈지 물어요. canonical 표면 순서: `nb3 al7nan ki tkhrj tshri m3 bntha : 3am bash tkhrji li 3rwsa nti . ana nlbs sbati w nkhrj ma n9ar3sh . khatsh ndir 3lik ntia 7ta al3sha' ndkhl ldari . baghi 7ta i9wlwa manish 3arfa win kant haima hi w bntha fi ns liali . mama ndi hadi w la hadi .`.

latin: jaia tbghi al7rir w li ib9s
english: The speaker says she is coming wanting silk and mentions the one who cuts it; the short line is incomplete and the action is source-ambiguous.
korean: 화자는 비단을 원하며 오고 있고 그것을 자르는 사람을 언급해요. 짧은 문장이라 행동은 불투명하고 불완전해요.

latin: kwn n9wlk tdi hadi tdiha ma n3rfksh rask khshin . dbr rask . ana 3jbtni hadi . w 3lah ma tdish lkhra mstwra baghi trw7i t3ri li fi aljam3a hak rbitk ana .
english: The speaker says ‘if I tell you to take this one, take it’; calls the listener hard-headed; says ‘look after yourself’; says ‘I like this one’; asks why the other modest one is not chosen; and says the female addressee wants to go to the university and expose herself. No third woman is added. Canonical surface sequence: `kwn n9wlk tdi hadi tdiha ma n3rfksh rask khshin . dbr rask . ana 3jbtni hadi . w 3lah ma tdish lkhra mstwra baghi trw7i t3ri li fi aljam3a hak rbitk ana .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘내가 이것을 가지라고 하면 가져’라고 하고 상대를 고집 세다고 부르며 ‘네 앞가림이나 해’라고 해요. ‘나는 이것이 마음에 들어’라고 하고 다른 단정한 것을 왜 고르지 않느냐고 묻고 여성 청자가 대학에서 자기 자신을 드러내러 간다고 말해요. 제3의 여성을 추가하지 않아요. canonical 표면 순서: `kwn n9wlk tdi hadi tdiha ma n3rfksh rask khshin . dbr rask . ana 3jbtni hadi . w 3lah ma tdish lkhra mstwra baghi trw7i t3ri li fi aljam3a hak rbitk ana .`.

latin: 3lik al7md . ana 7sbtk tghashiti dakhl . saii mama ghadi ndi hadi . sh3al dir hadi wldi ? khmsia alf 7aja . 3nd jark dir ghir 200 alf bla m3awda . ia wldi dir m3aha mskina m3ndhash 3ndk 3ndha 50 alf ftzdam . la mama 3ndi bl3i fmk .
english: The speaker says praise be to God and thought the listener was angry; mother will take the item; asks its price; says fifty thousand; compares the neighbour’s two hundred thousand without exchange; asks the son to be kind because the woman has fifty thousand; and ends ‘No, mother, I have money—shut your mouth’ as the speaker’s turn. Canonical surface sequence: `3lik al7md . ana 7sbtk tghashiti dakhl . saii mama ghadi ndi hadi . sh3al dir hadi wldi ? khmsia alf 7aja . 3nd jark dir ghir 200 alf bla m3awda . ia wldi dir m3aha mskina m3ndhash 3ndk 3ndha 50 alf ftzdam . la mama 3ndi bl3i fmk .`.
korean: 화자는 신을 찬양하며 상대가 화난 줄 알았다고 해요. 엄마가 물건을 가져갈 거라고 하고 가격을 묻고 5만이라고 해요. 이웃의 교환 없는 20만과 비교하고 여성에게 5만밖에 없으니 아들에게 잘해 달라고 한 뒤 화자가 ‘아니 엄마, 나 돈 있어. 입 다물어’라고 마무리해요. canonical 표면 순서: `3lik al7md . ana 7sbtk tghashiti dakhl . saii mama ghadi ndi hadi . sh3al dir hadi wldi ? khmsia alf 7aja . 3nd jark dir ghir 200 alf bla m3awda . ia wldi dir m3aha mskina m3ndhash 3ndk 3ndha 50 alf ftzdam . la mama 3ndi bl3i fmk .`.

latin: aia wldi ntklwa 3la allh 50 alf rbi inj7k . la mimti mafihash . hahw wjhi ada rb7t nwdi khrji 9dami khian .
english: The speakers decide to trust God and mention fifty thousand, wish success, reject the mother’s response, and say ‘here is my face’; if the speaker wins, the other person should leave before them, called a traitor. The exchange is comic and source-close.
korean: 화자들은 신을 믿자고 하며 5만을 언급하고 성공을 빌어요. 엄마의 말을 거부하고 ‘여기 내 얼굴이 있어’라고 하며 자신이 이기면 상대가 자신보다 먼저 나가라고 하고 배신자라고 부르는 코미디 turn이에요.

latin: shwfi ada 3awdt khrjt m3ak ma ntsmash mn sba7 w nti dwri li 3jb w m3jb ma i3jbksh bs7 ana fia lafwt m3lish nstahl .
english: The speaker says that if they go out with the listener again, they will not be named or recognized after the morning, because the listener turns around whatever they like and dislike; the speaker admits having a fault and deserving it.
korean: 화자는 상대와 다시 외출하면 아침부터 자신의 이름을 말할 수 없을 것이라고 해요. 상대가 좋아하는 것과 싫어하는 것을 마음대로 돌린다고 하며 자신에게 잘못이 있고 그럴 만하다고 인정해요.

latin: darna fi al3rdat . aia khfwa jibwna zwj ghraif 7rira sha rakm dirwa mn sba7 shashra rahm i9ar3wa . sha raki daira nti lbsi khmar stri rw7k jaitni kima hak 9dam rjal .
english: The speaker says ‘come quickly’; asks what the others have done since morning, keeping ‘shashra rahm i9ar3wa’ opaque; asks for two plates of harira; and tells the woman to wear a khimar and cover herself before men. Canonical surface sequence: `darna fi al3rdat . aia khfwa jibwna zwj ghraif 7rira sha rakm dirwa mn sba7 shashra rahm i9ar3wa . sha raki daira nti lbsi khmar stri rw7k jaitni kima hak 9dam rjal .`.
korean: 화자는 ‘어서 와’라고 하고 ‘shashra rahm i9ar3wa’는 불투명하게 둔 채 아침부터 무엇을 했는지 물어요. 하리라 두 접시를 가져오라고 하고 여성에게 키마르를 쓰고 남자들 앞에서 몸을 가리라고 해요. canonical 표면 순서: `darna fi al3rdat . aia khfwa jibwna zwj ghraif 7rira sha rakm dirwa mn sba7 shashra rahm i9ar3wa . sha raki daira nti lbsi khmar stri rw7k jaitni kima hak 9dam rjal .`.

latin: ia khti shir amn rahi iz9i 3lia . khwia nta ghir wld jwarin 9a3d takl fi rw7k . dkhl 7rira a bl3 .
english: The speaker keeps the opaque ‘shir amn’; says the woman is shouting at the speaker; calls the listener only the neighbour’s son; says ‘do not eat yourself’; and says ‘bring in the harira and eat’. Canonical surface sequence: `ia khti shir amn rahi iz9i 3lia . khwia nta ghir wld jwarin 9a3d takl fi rw7k . dkhl 7rira a bl3 .`.
korean: 화자는 불투명한 ‘shir amn’을 보존하고 여성이 자신에게 소리친다고 해요. 상대를 그저 이웃의 아들이라고 부르고 ‘자신을 먹지 마’라고 한 뒤 ‘하리라를 들여와 먹어’라고 해요. canonical 표면 순서: `ia khti shir amn rahi iz9i 3lia . khwia nta ghir wld jwarin 9a3d takl fi rw7k . dkhl 7rira a bl3 .`.

latin: wldi bit alma win allh i7fz . rah lhiha 7aja kain ma bash nstja . wah ja ghir shwia hak alma 7aja . s7a wldi .
english: The speaker asks where the bathroom/toilet is; says it is for istinja/post-toilet cleansing; the reply says only a little came out—‘here, water’; and the speaker ends ‘thanks, my son’. Canonical surface sequence: `wldi bit alma win allh i7fz . rah lhiha 7aja kain ma bash nstja . wah ja ghir shwia hak alma 7aja . s7a wldi .`.
korean: 화자는 화장실이 어디인지 묻고 용변 후 세정·이스틴자를 위한 곳이라고 해요. 응답은 ‘조금밖에 안 나왔어, 여기 물’이라고 하고 화자는 ‘고마워, 아들아’라고 끝내요. canonical 표면 순서: `wldi bit alma win allh i7fz . rah lhiha 7aja kain ma bash nstja . wah ja ghir shwia hak alma 7aja . s7a wldi .`.

latin: ghadi ndkhl nstnja 7mbwk jbdli srbita t3 kr3in bash nshf kr3ia w ntwda w jibli mfta7 t3 hadik albit alli rakm dasin fiha 9atw nbghi nsli fskat .
english: The speaker says they are going to the bathroom, asks for a towel for their feet so they can dry them and perform ablution, and asks for the key to the room where the cat is hidden because they want to pray quietly.
korean: 화자는 용변을 보러 가며 발을 닦고 세정 의식을 할 수 있도록 발 수건을 달라고 해요. 고양이를 숨겨 둔 방의 열쇠를 달라고 하며 조용히 기도하고 싶다고 해요.

latin: rakm tshwfwa fi hdik shibania alli raha liha . hadik shrira . wah kl 15 d9i9a t9l3 fmha tnfkhh bma . khs ki t9l3h had khtra nrw7wa njrwa ndirw lha hak ndwlha fmha nrdma h ftrab . iadra khta shftha fi mbs 2 .
english: The speaker points out an old woman who is a bad person, says she pulls her mouth and fills it with water every fifteen minutes, and jokes that next time they will run over and bury her mouth in the dirt, referring to a plan seen in MBS2.
korean: 화자는 저기 있는 노년 여성이 못된 사람이라고 말하고 15분마다 입을 당겨 물로 부풀린다고 해요. 다음에는 달려가 그 여성의 입을 흙에 묻겠다고 농담하며 MBS2에서 본 계획을 언급해요.

latin: mama baba ja idik 9alk arwa7i nwslk 9bl ma nwslk lstad hwd 9lh iwli mnb3d jaini drwk had win 7lat aljma3a . ia rajlk ma i9wlk walw . sha rah mdkhlk ntia raki tm3nili bash nrw7 z3ma . hna n93d frshwli rani baita .
english: The father comes to pick the listener up; the source keeps the opaque instruction to go down and tell him to come back later; says the gathering has just become lively; says the husband will not object; asks ‘are you hinting that I should go?’; and asks for a bed because the speaker will stay overnight. Canonical surface sequence: `mama baba ja idik 9alk arwa7i nwslk 9bl ma nwslk lstad hwd 9lh iwli mnb3d jaini drwk had win 7lat aljma3a . ia rajlk ma i9wlk walw . sha rah mdkhlk ntia raki tm3nili bash nrw7 z3ma . hna n93d frshwli rani baita .`.
korean: 아버지가 상대를 데리러 오고, 불투명한 ‘내려가서 나중에 다시 오라고 해’라는 지시를 보존해요. 모임이 이제 막 재미있어졌다고 하고 남편은 반대하지 않을 거라고 해요. ‘내가 가라고 눈치 주는 거야?’라고 묻고 하룻밤 묵을 테니 잠자리를 펴 달라고 해요. canonical 표면 순서: `mama baba ja idik 9alk arwa7i nwslk 9bl ma nwslk lstad hwd 9lh iwli mnb3d jaini drwk had win 7lat aljma3a . ia rajlk ma i9wlk walw . sha rah mdkhlk ntia raki tm3nili bash nrw7 z3ma . hna n93d frshwli rani baita .`.
